_comment: hooked_tty_getlin() Ctrl-P recall over a prompt longer than one row. An empty answer to an uncursed genocide scroll's first prompt makes do_genocide() ask again with the long cmdassist prompt. Ctrl-P under msg_window:single redraws gt.toplines, which getlin rebuilt with strcpy(), so redotoplin() wraps it at the terminal edge rather than at a space (topl.c topl_putsym()). The next key after a recall both redraws the prompt and is processed as input (getline.c doprev arm): 'c' is typed, Escape restarts the empty prompt, backspace rings the bell.
